### In-Shop Groomers

**Convenience**

We come directly to your door, saving you time and effort. We take only 10 minutes of your time and you can relax at home while we groom your dog.

Often takes over 3 hours of your day due to travel, drop-off, and waiting. Grooming may take longer due to groomers handling multiple dogs at once.

**Low Stress Experience**

Dogs are groomed in a calm, quiet environment inside the van, away from other dogs and ringing phones.

Car rides to the groomer and a chaotic, noisy shop environment can be stressful for many dogs.

**Personalized Attention**

Groomers focus entirely on one dog at a time, ensuring a calm, tailored experience.

Groomers often handle multiple dogs at once, leading to rushed service and less personalized care.

**Safety and Hygiene**

Groombuggy vans are cleaned and sanitized after each session ensuring no exposure to other dogs' illnesses.

Shops may have inconsistent cleanliness, with potential exposure to other animals' illnesses.

**More Options**

With an extensive team of expert groomers, we can find the perfect match for your dog in a timely manner.

Limited groomer availability can result in longer wait times and inconsistent quality.

**24/7 Support**

Our team is available 24/7 to schedule, answer questions, and address any concerns.

Phone support is only available during shop hours, and groomers may be too busy to answer.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87f1f3831bb8939f11_leash.svg)

## Unleashing a new era of dog grooming

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f8701cddd9260f47494_dog1.svg)

### Stress-Free

Our calm, private grooming space is tailored for your dog’s undivided attention. Ideal for anxious pups.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f8706364a587bfe74b0_dog2.svg)

### High Quality

Top-tier shampoos, vet-rated cleaning solutions, breed-specific brushes, and unmatched expertise.  

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f86f29682eaff3e1b19_dog3.svg)

### Convenient

Forget the 4-hour trips to the groomer. We're at your doorstep on your schedule. It's grooming on your terms!  

[Book Now!](https://www.groombuggy.com/book)

No **credit card** required.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87e930a871196bf5f9_bone-green.svg)

## Grooming made simple for you and your dog

[Learn About Our Services](https://www.groombuggy.com/services)

Learn about our services

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f86e8b8705e88521c7f_bath.svg)

### Bath

Our vans are loaded with fresh, warm water because baths are crucial to the grooming process. We use premium shampoos and conditioners tailored to your dog’s needs but if you have a prescribed medicated shampoo, we're happy to use that too (a small additional fee applies).

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f86630a7bdf3e6ed6b1_blowout.svg)

### Blow Out

There are no cages onboard our vans. We hand-dry your pup from nose to tail. This process not only sheds excess fur but also preps those thick, furry coats for haircuts. Plus, it's a perfect time for your groomer to inspect your dog’s skin and coat for issues not readily visible.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87d2145803f403ec51_haircut.svg)

### Haircut

Every pup has their own style. Whether it's a neat summer shave or just a little off the top, your groomer will consult with you to match your requests while honoring your pet’s health and safety.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87e06f5889b5276338_brush.svg)

### Brush

Your groomer is equipped with the highest quality brushes, combs, and tools that suit your dog’s needs and ensures their fur ends up feeling as good as it looks.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87e06f5889b5276342_ears.svg)

### Ears

We only use top-tier, vet-approved ear cleaners for your pup. We’ll pluck those floppy (or pointy) ears upon request (additional fee applies) and if we spot any irritation or infection, we'll let you know.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f878f681cf1d3cdd018_nails.svg)

### Nails

Maintaining the right nail length is crucial for your pup's health and well-being. We include nail dremeling (filing) in our service, but if your dog isn't a fan, we'll switch to clipping.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f87f1f3831bb8939f15_teeth%20brushing.svg)

### Teeth Brushing

We use vet-approved toothpaste and soft bristle toothbrushes to boost your pup’s oral health and freshen their breath. Your groomer will report any signs of poor dental health so you can address it.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f8645b51791f5b7ff7c_anal%20expression.svg)

### Anal Gland Expression

Some dogs need more care in this department. Upon request, we'll provide this service at no extra charge. Unsure if it’s necessary? Your groomer will be there to advise, or you can consult your vet.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610857d9a588acd1a84fd9bd/65417f877ad63e064841a2f5_fetch.svg)
